name: Falling With Style
summary: At Thendal Village, Myriaal Mistwake sends young Skyborne from a watchtower to test their falling skill. They glide down to Rorian the Dayseeker below.

sections.title: A Leap from the Tower
sections.body: High above Thendal Village on Zephras Isle, Myriaal Mistwake invites young Skyborne to test their heritage with a daring leap. She urges newcomers to step from the watchtower ledge and trust their gift for slowing a fall. The practice is playful, yet it prepares them to walk on air when danger comes beyond the grove.

sections.title: A Difference in Temperament
sections.body: Myriaal delights in sudden descents that startle onlookers, while Rorian the Dayseeker favors caution. As novices glide down to land before him, he warns that careless use of their magic may leave travelers helpless in danger. Still, he accepts that controlled practice within the village has its place.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The leap lets novice Skyborne practice controlling a slow descent from a height with their natural magic.

faq.q: Who gives the quest and where?
aliases: where to start falling with style
faq.answer: Myriaal Mistwake gives it from the wooden watchtower above Thendal Village on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Who do you land in front of?
faq.answer: You land near Rorian the Dayseeker, whom Myriaal hopes to startle with the leap.

faq.q: Why is Rorian upset by the jump?
faq.answer: Rorian believes Skyborne should use their natural magic with discipline, not waste it on practical jokes that startle people.
You practice Walk on Air, the skyborne gift that slows a fall and prevents injury from landing.
The practice takes place in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle, the Skyborne's ancestral starting grounds.

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you learn to slow your fall and hear the debate over how carefully to use your natural wind-walking magic.
